transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I came in because most days I just feel really low. Like I’m stuck at the bottom of some dark hole, and even around people I know, I can’t shake this heavy, hopeless feeling.
How long have you been feeling this low?
About… a year and a couple months, I guess. Since that fall on the HVAC job messed up my back, things just kind of started coming apart.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling this way?

Yeah… I don’t really enjoy much anymore. I used to like hiking, painting, messing around at the makerspace, even figuring out a hard install at work. Now I mostly just… stare at the supplies, or don’t answer when people call. It all feels like too much to even start.
Do you still feel pleasure when you're doing things that you used to enjoy, even if you don't feel like doing them as much?
Not really. Even if I try… hiking, painting, tinkering with stuff, it just feels flat. I mostly end up staring at it or putting it off. Doesn’t feel worth starting anymore.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
I don’t know… not in a way I’ve really kept track of. I get tense sometimes, I guess, but I’m not sure I’d call it worry.
Do you feel any pleasure at all when you're doing things, even if it's not as much as you used to?

Maybe a little, but… mostly no. Stuff I used to love—hiking, painting, tinkering at the makerspace—it just doesn’t really land anymore. I’ll look at the supplies and not even start. Even when people call, I just… ignore it. It doesn’t feel worth it.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself or wished you were dead?

...Yeah. I don’t like saying that, but yeah.

I’ve had thoughts like… maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And when the pain and money stuff piles up, sometimes my mind goes to ending it. It scares me, though.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?

I haven’t really checked the scale much. My eating’s been… messed up. I’ll go most of the day just having coffee because food feels gross, and then late at night I’ll pick at whatever’s around. Not really hungry, just… doing it.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to, or that your thoughts are racing or harder to keep up with?
Yeah… slower. Everything takes me longer than it should. Even just getting up from the couch or answering someone… it’s like I’m moving through water. People notice, I think. They ask if I’m okay.
Do you find that your low mood or energy levels change with the seasons?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed a seasonal thing. It just feels low most of the time lately.
Do you often feel restless or have an inability to sit still?

Not really restless… it’s more the opposite. I’m just slow with everything. Even getting from the couch to the kitchen, or answering a simple question, it takes me longer. People keep asking if I’m okay because I guess I move like I’m underwater.
Have you noticed any periods, even brief ones, where your low mood significantly lifted or where you felt okay for a while since this all started?

Not really. I mean… there might be moments where I’m distracted, but it doesn’t really lift. Most days it just feels like I’m down in some dark hole, and even around people I know, that heavy hopeless feeling is still there.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are not your own or that someone or something is controlling your mind?
No… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like mine. They’re just… not very good lately.
Are there any activities where you still feel some pleasure?

Not really. I used to like hiking, painting… going to the makerspace and messing with projects. Even work stuff, figuring out a tricky install, used to feel good. Now I mostly just stare at the supplies or don’t answer people’s calls. It just doesn’t feel worth starting.
Have you had any periods, no matter how short, where you felt nearly back to normal since your mood started to decline?
No… not really. Maybe I get distracted for a minute, but I don’t feel normal. It’s still like I’m down in that dark place, even around people. That heavy feeling doesn’t really go away.
Are there any small things that still give you some joy or pleasure?

Not much, no. I mean… those used to be the small things, hiking or painting, messing with stuff at the makerspace. Even a hard install at work. Now I mostly just look at it or don’t pick up when people call. It doesn’t really… feel worth starting.
Have you had any periods of at least two weeks where you felt significantly better since your mood started to decline?
No… I don’t think so. It’s been pretty steady since the fall at that HVAC job, when I hurt my back. About a year and two months now, I guess.
Have you had at least two weeks in a row since your mood started declining where you felt consistently low?
Yeah… it’s been like that most days. I feel like I’m down at the bottom of some dark hole, and even around people I know, that heavy hopeless feeling doesn’t really lift.
Do you feel worse in the morning?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern like that… mornings aren’t good, but I don’t know if they’re worse.
